author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a round disc split by its vertical diameter into two halves, ringed by eight detached rays (cardinal and diagonal) starting 8 beyond the rim; reads as a brightness sun. A first candidate inked the right half solid with an overlapping r4 arc; the build gate rejected it (2 undersized holes, 2 pinches, negative internal clearance). The rejected drawing had rays fused to the disc (ship's-wheel look) and a solid D blob.
omissions: The reference's inner D (a half disc inside the circle) cannot fit 8 units inside a disc small enough to leave room for detached rays; it is reduced to the circle's own right half, marked off by the diameter. Rays are short dashes.
drawing_plan: Disc r8 at (24,24) with vertical diameter; rays r16..20 on the axes, (12,12)..(14,14) on the diagonals.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'sun' (circle with eight detached rays) and 'contrast' (circle split into halves).
